query:
SELECT slug, status FROM blog_posts WHERE slug IN (
  'mouth-ulcer-not-healing','overtreatment-concerns','pain-when-biting-or-chewing',
  'pre-authorization','preventive-care-gap','rushed-decisions','silent-gum-disease',
  'stained-teeth','teeth-grinding','teeth-grinding-bruxism','tooth-hurts-cold-water',
  'tooth-sensitivity','unclear-diagnoses','undetected-cavities','waiting-periods',
  'white-spots-on-teeth','wisdom-teeth-confusion'
) ORDER BY slug;
